Corollary
[Small almost-flat tori lie in cusps] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0212 ↗ thm:chow-iv-finite-volume-ends-cusps 1. ch31:31.47\group Hyperbolic cusps

For every $C<\infty $, sufficiently small intrinsic sectional curvature and area, together with $|\mathrm{II}|\le C$, force an embedded 2-torus in a finite-volume hyperbolic 3-manifold to lie in a maximal cusp end.
